title: Sunset Dreams Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Sunset Dreams is a 1.00 bedroom, 1.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Sunset Dreams | Luxury Gulf-View Vacation Rental in Seaside, FloridaPerched atop the iconic, award-winning Holl Building in Dreamland Heights, Sunset Dreams is a newly introduced, beautifully renovated modern suite offering sweeping views of the Gulf, downtown Seaside, and the vibrant Seaside Amphitheater below. Designed by renowned architect Steven Holl, this elevated Seaside vacation rental blends striking architecture with coastal comfort and accommodates up to four guests, making it ideal for couples or small families seeking a luxury stay in the heart of Seaside, Florida.Thoughtfully Designed Coastal InteriorsStep inside to an airy, coastal-inspired interior where natural light and modern finishes create an inviting retreat. The entry foyer sits beside a newly renovated half bath, setting the tone for both comfort and convenience. The first level features a spacious king primary suite with built-in storage, a dedicated desk area, a large flat-screen TV, and expansive windows that frame stunning town and Gulf views. Just steps away, the full bathroom offers a spa-like experience with a marble vanity and a glass-enclosed walk-in shower with multiple rain shower heads.Modern Kitchen & Open Living SpaceA striking spiral staircase leads to the second level, where an open-concept layout invites relaxation and entertaining. The fully renovated kitchen showcases sleek black stone countertops and premium stainless steel appliances, including a four-burner electric cooktop, full-size Sub-Zero refrigerator, microwave, dishwasher, and Keurig coffee maker. Adjacent dining seating for three flows seamlessly into the living area, which features a large flat-screen TV with soundbar, a plush sofa with a queen sleeper, and two club chairs for additional seating.Private Balcony with Panoramic Gulf ViewsThe highlight of Sunset Dreams is the private, furnished balcony, offering unobstructed views of Seaside and the sparkling Gulf just across the street. With bar seating for four, this elevated outdoor space is perfect for enjoying sunsets over the Gulf, people-watching in the town center, or catching Fourth of July and New Year’s Eve fireworks from the comfort of your suite.Unbeatable Location in the Heart of SeasideLocated just steps from Seaside’s white-sand beaches, boutique shopping, acclaimed restaurants, and live entertainment at the amphitheater, Sunset Dreams places you at the center of it all. Whether you’re here for a romantic escape, a weekend getaway, or a coastal retreat, this luxury Seaside vacation rental offers an unforgettable stay along Florida’s Scenic Highway 30A—your perfect home away from home on the Gulf Coast.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. ** Please be advised that neighboring properties may currently be undergoing construction or renovation during your stay. As a result, intermittent noise or construction-related activity may occur at certain times throughout the day. This work is managed by third parties outside of our control, and we appreciate your understanding while enjoying the property. For additional questions or concerns regarding nearby construction activity, please contact Homeowner’s Collection at 1-855-411-1557.FEATURES727 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space3-minute walk (approximately 500 feet) to Coleman beach access, placing you just steps from the GulfSeaside beach access at Coleman Pavilion for a convenient and scenic entry point to the sandAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, and 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerNo washer or dryer in this unitThis home streams live TV through YouTubeTV, so you can catch local channels, sports, and favorite shows right from the smart TVsWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityGolf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside; special circumstances and medical needs require an approved golf cart permitPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities thoughtfully providedOne parking pass is provided with this unit. Parking outside the Holl Building is limited to 5 designated guest spots, shared on a first-come, first-served basis. Should those fill up, guests may park at no charge anywhere around Smolian Circle, provided the parking pass is displayed on the rearview mirrorNo pets allowed
